title: Risk Treatment Decision Tree
description: Interactive Mermaid decision tree that routes a single identified risk through the four ISO-style treatment options: avoid, mitigate, transfer, or accept.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Apply the four-option risk-treatment model to select avoid, mitigate, transfer, or accept for a given risk.
Explain why transfer moves financial impact but not operational responsibility.
Justify that risk acceptance must be deliberate, signed, and time-bound.
educational.prerequisites: Familiarity with likelihood-by-impact risk rating and the idea of residual risk.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to choose and justify a treatment for described risk scenarios.
misconceptionsAddressed: Treating acceptance as a default rather than a deliberate, dated decision.
Believing transfer (insurance) removes the operational impact of an event.
